Subject: POC charter & success criteria — Biotune evaluation (MAP kickoff)

Hi Claire / Tom —

Thanks again for the conversation earlier. Per our call, I wanted to put a concise MAP kickoff message in one place so we can lock owners and the success criteria for the 6-week POC. Attached is a MAP template (lightweight) and a short benchmark spec outline to get us started.

Proposed kickoff goals:
- Finalize stakeholders & owners by EOD Friday
- Agree on 3 measurable success criteria (quality, latency, cost) by next Wed
- Baseline evaluation tests and provide initial prompt bank by week 2

Draft success criteria (suggested):
- Generation quality: end-to-end extraction accuracy >= 92% on our pilot set (macro F1), no regressions vs baseline
- Latency: p50 generation latency < 400ms for 256-token requests in our dedicated config
- Cost: token cost per successful inference reduces total query cost by 25% vs current pipeline

Roles I propose:
- Customer data & success lead: Claire (data access, sample selection)
- Redwood integration & infra lead: Jordan (endpoint config, certs, VPC peering if needed)
- Redwood eval lead (prompts & metrics): Rishi (prompt bank, automated evals, scripts)
- Redwood CS & program lead: Marissa (weekly syncs, escalation, MAP owner)

Can you confirm if these owners look right and whether there are any internal stakeholders at Biotune we should add (e.g., regulatory/compliance, ML ops)? Once we lock owners I will share a filled MAP and calendar for the kickoff + weekly checkpoints.

Attachments: redwood_map_template_v2.xlsx (xlsx), biotune-eval-benchmark-specs.pdf (pdf)

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
Cell: +1 (415) 555-0193
